name: OpenEden USDO
description: USDO is collateralized by tokenized U.S. Treasury Bills and money market funds (such as OpenEden’s TBILL), from which USDO’s yield is generated. The reserves serve as the foundation for maintaining a minimum 100% collateralization ratio, meaning every USDO token in circulation is fully backed by equivalent assets

methodology.Fees: All fees from users mint/redeem USDO, yields and management fees from backing assets.
methodology.UserFees: Users pay fees to minting/redeeming USDO.
methodology.Revenue: Mint/redeem USDO fees and 0.3% annual is charged by the Investment Manager.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Mint/redeem USDO fees and 0.3% annual is charged by the Investment Manager.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Backing assets yields collected and distributed to suppliers via USDO token rebasing.

Fees.Assets Yields: USDO backing assets yields from all investments.

UserFees.Mint/Redeem Fees: Users pay fees when mint/redeem USDO.

SupplySideRevenue.Assets Yields: USDO backing assets yields from all investments.
